summary: The T0 underwriting bottleneck remains 249 unscored active companies, but the XTND capital-structure directive advances materially from primary SEC filings. A defensible provisional denominator is 277,442,600 pro forma weighted-average basic/diluted shares before new plan reserves; the S-8 registers 43,567,442 shares of rollover awards plus 2026 equity-plan and ESPP capacity, and two 10 million-share earnout tranches create additional contingent dilution. Pro forma gross liquidity is substantial but burn/runway cannot be closed cleanly without post-close cash-flow and working-capital data. No XTND methodology score or admission recommendation is justified yet.

materialFindings.finding: The authoritative cycle still has only one publishable methodology-1.0 score out of 250 active companies. Therefore 249 active companies remain underwriting-unknown for official ranking, regardless of validated identity/tradability or source health.

XTND is correctly treated as an outside challenger pending full methodology. The discovery artifact identifies Xtend AI Robotics, Inc. as NYSE-listed after the September 3, 2026 merger close and explicitly marks admissionEligible=false.

The SEC pro forma combined financials use 277,442,600 weighted-average basic and diluted shares for the six months ended June 30, 2026, consisting of Xtend ordinary-share conversion, preferred/warrant/SAFE conversion and JFB consideration shares. This is the cleanest current primary-source baseline denominator found for capital-structure normalization, but it is pro forma rather than a post-close transfer-agent count.

The September 2026 S-8 registers 43,567,442 shares: 9,936,483 shares underlying rollover equity awards, 18,630,959 shares under the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, and 15,000,000 shares under the 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Relative to the 277,442,600 pro forma denominator, total registered S-8 capacity is about 15.7%; the two new 2026 plan pools alone are about 12.1%. Registration is capacity, not evidence that all shares will be issued, and rollover awards must not be double-counted against already-converted merger securities.

The merger provides two contingent earnout tranches of 10,000,000 shares each if Xtend reaches at least $75 million of 2026 revenue and $150 million of 2027 revenue. Twenty million contingent shares equal about 7.2% of the 277,442,600 pro forma denominator. If every S-8 registered share and both earnout tranches were incremental, the combined headline capacity would be about 22.9% of the baseline denominator, but that is an overhang sensitivity case rather than a current fully diluted share count.

At merger close, Xtend shareholders were disclosed as holding approximately 87.41% of voting power and 79.61% of economic interests on a fully diluted basis excluding amounts reserved under the new equity plan. JFB-related holders retained approximately 12.59% voting and 20.39% economic interests. This ownership concentration is relevant to governance/alignment analysis and must be reconciled with pre-funded warrants and beneficial-ownership caps before a final governance score.

The pro forma balance sheet shows $39.779 million of combined cash plus a $60 million PIPE/cash contribution, while the filing also records approximately $15.52 million of merger bonuses/transaction costs. The six-month pro forma operating loss was approximately $34.465 million and net loss approximately $27.545 million. Using only those accounting figures produces a rough pre-capex/working-capital gross liquidity horizon near 1.2-1.5 years after subtracting the stated closing-cost accrual, but this is not a closure-quality cash-runway estimate because actual post-close cash burn, working capital, capex and timing of liabilities are not yet normalized.

The pro forma six-month net loss and operating loss remain large relative to revenue/gross profit, so capital-survival and dilution risk cannot be scored from listing excitement or deployment counts. The rubric requires explicit balance-sheet execution, dilution-adjusted value, solvency/dilution risk and Data Confidence evidence before publication.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Keep XTND outside and unscored until a full methodology-1.0 underwriting record is built. Capital-structure normalization should use 277,442,600 as the current provisional pro forma baseline denominator, then separately layer rollover awards, new plan reserves, pre-funded warrants and earnouts with explicit anti-double-counting checks.

Do not convert the rough 1.2-1.5 year accounting liquidity sensitivity into a canonical runway value. Obtain post-close cash/cash-flow, working-capital, capex, debt/pre-funded-warrant and operating-cash-flow detail first; until then treat financing dependence as elevated but quantitatively unresolved.

When XTND is fully underwritten, explicitly separate control concentration from economic dilution: governance/alignment should reflect concentrated voting control, while dilutionAdjustedValue and solvencyDilution should reflect plan reserves, rollover awards, earnouts and any pre-funded warrants only after the exact issued/outstanding and exercisable quantities are reconciled.

contradictions.issue: The pro forma filing describes 277,442,600 weighted-average basic and diluted shares while also disclosing beneficial-ownership caps that can replace shares with pre-funded warrants and excludes equity-plan reserves from the stated post-merger fully diluted ownership percentages. Therefore a single headline 'fully diluted shares' number cannot yet be asserted without reconciling those instruments.

unknowns.unknown: The exact post-close issued common shares outstanding, pre-funded warrants outstanding, and instrument-by-instrument fully diluted count have not been reconciled to a single post-close primary-source cap table.

A defensible XTND cash runway remains unknown because post-close operating cash flow, working-capital usage, capex, financing cash flows and actual timing of merger-cost cash payments are not normalized in the reviewed pro forma income/balance-sheet evidence.

XTND still lacks complete methodology-1.0 evidence across thesis quality, operating momentum, valuation, catalysts, governance, 2036 alignment, cross-division leverage, bottleneck control, scenario robustness, substitution resilience, supply-chain resilience, pricing power, risk and Data Confidence.
The other 249 unscored active companies remain without complete comparable underwriting and cannot be ranked from seed order, identity status or source reachability.

peerRequests.request: For XTND, preserve instrument-level provenance and anti-double-counting when reconciling the 277.4m pro forma denominator against post-close common shares, pre-funded warrants, rollover awards, plan reserves and earnouts.

Challenge XTND's capital-survival case using post-close cash-flow, customer concentration, contract quality, earnout incentives, related-party/control structure and dilution mechanics before any admission decision.
Do not use XTND's listing price or headline deployment count as an opportunity signal until a reconciled share count and dilution-adjusted valuation denominator exist.

accuracyDebates.topic: Should all S-8 registered shares be added mechanically to current fully diluted shares?
accuracyDebates.position: No. S-8 registration represents issuance capacity and includes rollover awards that may overlap with existing merger-related equity economics. Treat the 43.57m shares as disclosed overhang capacity and reconcile instrument-by-instrument before canonical fully diluted math.

accuracyDebates.topic: Does roughly $100m of pro forma gross cash prove a safe runway?
accuracyDebates.position: No. The company is loss-making and the reviewed pro forma statement does not provide a normalized post-close cash-flow runway. Gross liquidity is meaningful, but cash survival must remain an estimate range with lower confidence until actual cash burn and working-capital/capex needs are sourced.

blockingIssues.issue: XTND cannot be admitted or scored until the post-close cap table and capital-runway analysis are reconciled and a complete methodology-1.0 evidence record is built.
The T0 company-underwriting baseline remains incomplete because 249 of 250 active companies still lack complete publishable methodology-1.0 score records.

directivesReviewed.result: Material progress: provisional pro forma baseline shares, S-8 overhang, earnout dilution, ownership concentration and gross-liquidity sensitivity are normalized from SEC filings. Directive should remain open until exact post-close common/pre-funded-warrant counts and cash-flow-based runway are reconciled.
